#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>

typedef struct Node { int data; struct Node *link; } Node;
int count_nodes(Node *head) {
    int count = 0;
    for (Node *p = head; p != NULL; p = p->link) ++count;
    return count;
}
int main(void) {
    int n, value;
    Node *head = NULL, *tail = NULL;
    if (scanf("%d", &n) != 1 || n < 0) return 1;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        if (scanf("%d", &value) != 1) return 1;
        Node *p = malloc(sizeof *p);
        if (p == NULL) return 1;
        p->data = value;
        p->link = NULL;
        if (tail == NULL) head = p;
        else tail->link = p;
        tail = p;
    }
    printf("%d\n", count_nodes(head));
    while (head != NULL) {
        Node *next = head->link;

free(head);
        head = next;
    }
    return 0;
}

{

}

ListNode *reverse(ListNode *head)
{
    ListNode *p,*q,*r;
    p=head; q=NULL;
    while(p!=NULL) {
        r=q;
        q=p;
        p=p->link;
        q->link=r;
    }
    return q;
}
